final: WITH c AS (SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.staff_id, c.n, c.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM c JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.n, r.share, a.avg_n FROM r JOIN a ON a.avg_n IS NOT NULL WHERE r.n > a.avg_n) SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(n - avg_n) AS avg_diff FROM k
